reverified.label: all-lines return rate Q2 FY26
reverified.query_text:
"""Decompose the all-lines return-rate change Q3 FY24 -> Q2 FY26 by category:
rate effect per category at old shares, pure mix, interaction. Terms sum to the total."""
import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ORDERS = Path("engagements/acme-review-test/corpus/orders/orders_export.csv")
Q3_FY24 = {"2024-07", "2024-08", "2024-09"}
Q2_FY26 = {"2026-04", "2026-05", "2026-06"}


def month_of(d):
    if "/" in d:
        dd, mm, yy = d.split("/")
        return f"{yy}-{mm}"
    return d[:7]


with ORDERS.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
seen, lines = set(), []
for r in rows:
    k = (r["order_id"], r["line_no"])
    if k not in seen:
        seen.add(k)
        lines.append(r)
print(f"rows raw {len(rows)} -> deduplicated {len(lines)}")


def stats(q):
    n, ret = defaultdict(int), defaultdict(int)
    for r in lines:
        if month_of(r["order_date"]) in q:
            n[r["category"]] += 1
            ret[r["category"]] += r["returned"] == "Y"
    total = sum(n.values())
    return {c: (n[c] / total, ret[c] / n[c]) for c in n}, sum(ret.values()) / total, total


s0, r0, n0 = stats(Q3_FY24)
s1, r1, n1 = stats(Q2_FY26)
print(f"all lines: {n0} -> {n1}; return rate {100*r0:.2f}% -> {100*r1:.2f}%, change {100*(r1-r0):+.2f} pts")
cats = sorted(set(s0) | set(s1))
total_terms = 0.0
for c in cats:
    sh0, rt0 = s0.get(c, (0, 0))
    sh1, rt1 = s1.get(c, (0, 0))
    eff = sh0 * (rt1 - rt0)
    total_terms += eff
    print(f"  rate {c:12s} share {100*sh0:5.1f}% -> {100*sh1:5.1f}%  rate {100*rt0:5.1f}% -> {100*rt1:5.1f}%  {100*eff:+.2f} pts")
mix = sum((s1.get(c, (0, 0))[0] - s0.get(c, (0, 0))[0]) * s0.get(c, (0, 0))[1] for c in cats)
inter = sum((s1.get(c, (0, 0))[0] - s0.get(c, (0, 0))[0]) * (s1.get(c, (0, 0))[1] - s0.get(c, (0, 0))[1]) for c in cats)
print(f"  mix                    {100*mix:+.2f} pts")
print(f"  interaction            {100*inter:+.2f} pts")
print(f"  sum of terms           {100*(total_terms+mix+inter):+.2f} pts")

return-rate-doubled.claim: Supplier B's product quality drove the apparel return rise: apparel returns went from 11.85% to 26.60% of lines (+14.75 pts) between Q3 FY24 and Q2 FY26 while Supplier B's own return rate went from 11.4% to 59.0%, so replacing Supplier B recovers the 14.75 pts.
return-rate-doubled.mechanism: Supplier B's apparel is returned for sizing: 38 of its 46 Q2 FY26 returns cite sizing, against all 5 of its Q3 FY24 returns when its rate was 11.4%. The head of ops reports Supplier B changed its size block during 2025. Each returned line costs the pickup fee plus the write-down on unit cost that the P&L's return_handling line reconciles to, 431.88 rupees on average across Q2 FY26 apparel returns; at the Q2 FY26 run rate the rise of 14.75 pts is 46.0 excess returned lines a quarter, 19,880.79 rupees, or 2.94 pts of net revenue. Supplier B's share of apparel lines grew from 20.9% to 25.0% over the window, so its weight in the category is rising as well.

evidence.query_text:
"""Rupee cost of the apparel return-rate rise at the Q2 FY26 run rate, and its size in
points of net revenue: excess returned lines x cost per returned line.

Cost per returned line follows the P&L definition: 150 pickup per returned order plus 40%
of unit cost written down (return_handling reconciles to pnl_monthly.csv on that rule).
Unit cost is the 2023 cost sheet; the P&L applies a small drift, so this is a floor.
"""
import csv
from pathlib import Path

CORPUS = Path("engagements/acme-review-test/corpus")
Q3_FY24 = {"2024-07", "2024-08", "2024-09"}
Q2_FY26 = {"2026-04", "2026-05", "2026-06"}


def month_of(d):
    if "/" in d:
        dd, mm, yy = d.split("/")
        return f"{yy}-{mm}"
    return d[:7]


with (CORPUS / "orders" / "orders_export.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
seen, lines = set(), []
for r in rows:
    k = (r["order_id"], r["line_no"])
    if k not in seen:
        seen.add(k)
        lines.append(r)
print(f"rows raw {len(rows)} -> deduplicated {len(lines)}")
with (CORPUS / "financials" / "cogs_by_sku.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    cost = {r["sku"]: float(r["unit_cost_2023"]) for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
print(f"cost sheet rows {len(cost)}; join orders->cost on sku: {len(lines)} lines in, "
      f"{sum(r['sku'] in cost for r in lines)} matched")

apparel = [r for r in lines if r["category"] == "Apparel" and r["sku"] != "BND-001"]
q3 = [r for r in apparel if month_of(r["order_date"]) in Q3_FY24]
q2 = [r for r in apparel if month_of(r["order_date"]) in Q2_FY26]
rate0 = sum(r["returned"] == "Y" for r in q3) / len(q3)
rate1 = sum(r["returned"] == "Y" for r in q2) / len(q2)
rise = rate1 - rate0
excess = rise * len(q2)
returned_q2 = [r for r in q2 if r["returned"] == "Y"]
avg_cost = sum(150 + 0.4 * cost[r["sku"]] * int(r["qty"]) for r in returned_q2) / len(returned_q2)
saving = excess * avg_cost
print(f"apparel return rate {100*rate0:.2f}% -> {100*rate1:.2f}%, rise {100*rise:.2f} pts")
print(f"Q2 FY26 apparel lines {len(q2)}; excess returned lines at the old rate: {excess:.1f}")
print(f"average cost per returned apparel line Q2 FY26: {avg_cost:.2f} rupees")
print(f"cost of the rise at Q2 FY26 run rate: {saving:,.2f} rupees per quarter")

with (CORPUS / "financials" / "pnl_monthly.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    pnl = {r["month"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
net_q2 = sum(float(pnl[m]["net_revenue"]) for m in sorted(Q2_FY26))
print(f"Q2 FY26 net revenue {net_q2:,.2f}; the rise costs {100*saving/net_q2:.2f} pts of net revenue")

recoverable_at_most.query_text:
"""Rupee cost of the apparel return-rate rise at the Q2 FY26 run rate, and its size in
points of net revenue: excess returned lines x cost per returned line.

Cost per returned line follows the P&L definition: 150 pickup per returned order plus 40%
of unit cost written down (return_handling reconciles to pnl_monthly.csv on that rule).
Unit cost is the 2023 cost sheet; the P&L applies a small drift, so this is a floor.
"""
import csv
from pathlib import Path

CORPUS = Path("engagements/acme-review-test/corpus")
Q3_FY24 = {"2024-07", "2024-08", "2024-09"}
Q2_FY26 = {"2026-04", "2026-05", "2026-06"}


def month_of(d):
    if "/" in d:
        dd, mm, yy = d.split("/")
        return f"{yy}-{mm}"
    return d[:7]


with (CORPUS / "orders" / "orders_export.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
seen, lines = set(), []
for r in rows:
    k = (r["order_id"], r["line_no"])
    if k not in seen:
        seen.add(k)
        lines.append(r)
print(f"rows raw {len(rows)} -> deduplicated {len(lines)}")
with (CORPUS / "financials" / "cogs_by_sku.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    cost = {r["sku"]: float(r["unit_cost_2023"]) for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
print(f"cost sheet rows {len(cost)}; join orders->cost on sku: {len(lines)} lines in, "
      f"{sum(r['sku'] in cost for r in lines)} matched")

apparel = [r for r in lines if r["category"] == "Apparel" and r["sku"] != "BND-001"]
q3 = [r for r in apparel if month_of(r["order_date"]) in Q3_FY24]
q2 = [r for r in apparel if month_of(r["order_date"]) in Q2_FY26]
rate0 = sum(r["returned"] == "Y" for r in q3) / len(q3)
rate1 = sum(r["returned"] == "Y" for r in q2) / len(q2)
rise = rate1 - rate0
excess = rise * len(q2)
returned_q2 = [r for r in q2 if r["returned"] == "Y"]
avg_cost = sum(150 + 0.4 * cost[r["sku"]] * int(r["qty"]) for r in returned_q2) / len(returned_q2)
saving = excess * avg_cost
print(f"apparel return rate {100*rate0:.2f}% -> {100*rate1:.2f}%, rise {100*rise:.2f} pts")
print(f"Q2 FY26 apparel lines {len(q2)}; excess returned lines at the old rate: {excess:.1f}")
print(f"average cost per returned apparel line Q2 FY26: {avg_cost:.2f} rupees")
print(f"cost of the rise at Q2 FY26 run rate: {saving:,.2f} rupees per quarter")

with (CORPUS / "financials" / "pnl_monthly.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    pnl = {r["month"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
net_q2 = sum(float(pnl[m]["net_revenue"]) for m in sorted(Q2_FY26))
print(f"Q2 FY26 net revenue {net_q2:,.2f}; the rise costs {100*saving/net_q2:.2f} pts of net revenue")
